title: shadcn-ui/cn
why_read: A practical, widely-usable performance-focused replacement for tailwind-merge/clsx from a well-known UI library author, directly relevant to frontend engineers.
analysis: cn is a drop-in replacement for the popular tailwind-merge and clsx utilities used for resolving Tailwind CSS class conflicts, claiming full API parity with a 30x speed improvement. Coming from the shadcn/ui ecosystem, it likely has meaningful adoption and real-world impact on frontend build/runtime performance in Tailwind-heavy codebases. It's a narrow but concrete engineering optimization that many frontend developers will directly benefit from.
